description: July 4 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 2, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 4 birthday falls in Cancer, in the second decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: The July 4 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Twelve degrees into Cancer on the 4th of July, the Sun meets the steady number 4 and Pluto's decan of depth. This is traditionally read as a protective builder, someone who constructs secure homes, stable careers and firm boundaries around people they love. Change tends to come slowly for them, but when it does it is usually thorough.

Astronomically, July 4 puts the Sun near 12° Cancer in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Pluto. In the middle of Cancer, from 10 to 19 degrees, the sub-ruler is Pluto, the modern ruler of Scorpio. That brings an intensity to the Crab's tenderness. Early-July birthdays are often linked with emotional depth, loyalty that runs very deep, and a sharp instinct for what goes unsaid in a room. These Cancerians tend to protect privately and completely, sometimes keeping their own needs hidden behind the shell. Pluto adds resilience and a capacity for real renewal after loss. Learning to trust selectively, rather than all or nothing, usually helps the intensity become a source of steadiness instead of strain.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for July 4
paragraphs: A 4th-of-the-month birthday gives a birthday number of 4, with no further reduction needed. In numerology the birth day acts as a supplementary number, describing practical talents that sit beside the Life Path. The 4 stands for the square: four walls, four seasons, a stable base. Anyone born on the 4th is often pictured as organised, trustworthy and good at turning plans into schedules. They tend to prefer a method that has been tested to one that merely sounds exciting. The growing edge for 4s is usually flexibility, letting the structure bend when circumstances genuinely change.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a July 4 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous July 4 birthdays
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 4 is the 185th day of the year (186th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Leo, is usually complete within 19 days, by July 23.

By July 4 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a July 4 birthday are Calvin Coolidge (1872), Giuseppe Garibaldi (1807) and Nathaniel Hawthorne (1804).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 4?
faq.answer: July 4 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 4?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 4 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 4th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 4?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 4, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 4?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on July 4 include Calvin Coolidge (1872), Giuseppe Garibaldi (1807) and Nathaniel Hawthorne (1804). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
